text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan satta feere'en ɓee: anndee ko mi neɗɗanke wano mon. Allah wahayinii e am, wonnde Reweteeɗo mon on ka goonga, ko Reweteeɗo gooto pet, woni Kanko Allah. haray ñiiɓee e ngol laawol ɗon, ɗaɓɓiron Mo haforaneede junuubi mon. Halkaare e lepte woodanii sirkooɓe rewooɓe ko wanaa Allah ɓen, e kafidoowɓe e Makko ɓen.
